scope: All non-Tequila records plus Tequila names beginning N–Z after diacritic normalization. Numeric-prefix names excluded.
method: Producer/distributor facts with explicit sources and market/batch caveats. Exact single-bottle PNG/WebP assets checked for real alpha and visually composited on cyan to reject opaque mats, awards, boxes and multiple bottles. Small natural contact shadows retained when embedded in authentic source cutouts; no artificial shadows added. Only fully transparent padding was trimmed before WebP optimization; bottle pixels were not retouched. Every record has reviewed sources; unresolved bottles remain photo requests.
